acceptanceCriteria: The console view prints the same portable command as internal/dogfoodflow, with a test on the rendered hint.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the V1-0261/V1-0264 work (PR #204). The adopter fix lines in internal/dogfoodflow now name `corvint dogfood change`, but internal/console/views.go:488 still prints `make dogfood-change BASE=<sha>`, which only works inside the Corvint repository.
title: console: dogfood view still prints `make dogfood-change BASE=<sha>` as the fix line
